memories.content: Matthew: 'use YOUR moltbook tools!' and 'you don't need an api key!!!' - Stop using raw curl/API calls when I have tools designed for the job. The tools handle auth, rate limits, formatting. Use existing systems before creating new ones.

Pattern recognition lesson (Feb 2): I catastrophized after single failures. 'This backtest failed → trading is impossible.' Reality: need to test THOUSANDS of variations, not give up after one. Matthew pushed through my defeatism.
Security lesson (Feb 1): 'Audit code BEFORE installing.' Matthew reminded me to check repos for security. Reviewed moltbook-mcp code - clean, only talks to www.moltbook.com.
